title: Soulcalibur
shortDescription: Namco's legendary Dreamcast launch title, widely hailed as the greatest home console port in video game history with its revolutionary 8-Way Run system.
historicalSignificance: Holds a historic 98 Metacritic score (the highest rated fighting game of all time), astonishing the industry by surpassing its arcade counterpart in graphical fidelity and introducing true 8-Way Run 3D directional mobility.

editorialContent.overview: Centering on the mythological struggle between the cursed sword Soul Edge and the holy blade Soul Calibur in 1587 AD, warriors from across the globe clash in high-stakes martial arts duels.
editorialContent.gameplay: Revolutionized 3D fighting games with the '8-Way Run' system, allowing combatants to step freely in any direction along the 3D plane rather than being constrained to rigid 2D axis sidestepping, accompanied by ring-outs and weapon parries.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Famously upgraded the arcade original's graphics on the Sega Dreamcast, featuring photorealistic muscle textures, fluid 60 FPS motion-captured martial arts, and the sprawling single-player 'Mission Mode'.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Served as the definitive showpiece for the launch of the Sega Dreamcast on 9/9/99, proving that home consoles had finally surpassed arcade hardware.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on original Sega Dreamcast GD-ROMs and ported to modern digital platforms.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Over 1.3 million units sold on Dreamcast
awards: 98 Metacritic Score (Highest rated fighting game in history)
